supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 had repeated connections to the internal proxy at approximately five-minute intervals during much of the alert window, including at 13:30:03, 13:36:22, 13:41:10, 13:46:34, 13:51:47, 13:55:57, 14:01:14, and 14:06:22 UTC.

The listed Zeek connections are to 10.30.20.30:8080, the internal proxy, and show recurring byte counts of roughly 5–6 KB sent and about 30 KB received for several connections; these records do not identify the external HTTPS destination.

After the alert window, OneDrive started and Chrome made successful requests to SharePoint, showing that approved Microsoft services were in use at that time; this does not establish what caused the earlier recurring connections.
